description: Account, copy state, open positions, Hyperliquid balance and network, and copiesOnHold { held, reasons, coins }: held is true when new copies would not open now. Reasons: not_activated (sign-up not finished), paused, trial_expired, plan_expired, key_invalid (trading key expired or revoked: sign a new one), platform_paused, no_leaders, no_margin, not_unified (prudent, equilibre, risque: switch_to_unified_account), manual_positions (positions opened outside WakeTrades, listed in coins: close them, or the account owner allows copies anyway from the dashboard or Telegram), xyz_not_unified (advanced on a standard account: only the xyz markets are held, held stays false).
